thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1 runtime-prod-eu-2: crashlooping runtime-engine pods (10 restarts / 6m). SIGSEGV in libruntime.so observed. Affected: dedicated-acme, dedicated-healthfin. Paging @alice-sre and @ben-runtime. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/abc123
alice-sre: I'm on pager. grabbing logs now.
ben-runtime: seeing repeated 'invalid read' in fused kernel path, stack points to inference::KVCache::get
mike-sre: node-nv06 is flapping, GPU drivers reporting 'EFAULT' then device disappears. Kernel oops before container restarts.
priya-ml: is this the 2024-11 runtime build? last rollout included a fused-kernel change.
jordan-support: both Acme and HealthFin have active Reqs failing — we're seeing 5xx rates spike ~22% since 07:12 UTC. CS is preparing customer notifications.
alice-sre: mitigation plan: (1) cordon node-nv06, (2) drain pods, (3) scale up other nodes, (4) fallback model routing to cpu-backend for dedicated tenants. Can someone trigger routing change?
ben-runtime: I'll flip routing rule to prefer runtime-legacy for new requests. Command I plan to run: ```rbctl routing update --cluster eu --model default --prefer runtime-legacy --reason "pager: segfault"``` 
deploy-bot: Deploy started: routing-change/2026-03-15T07:20Z by ben-runtime. CI check passed.
alice-sre: cordoning node-nv06 now: `kubectl cordon node-nv06` — marked unschedulable. Mike, can you confirm driver state? 
mike-sre: driver logs attached; snippet: ```[ 07:14:02 ] nv_driver: gpu0: AER error: EFAULT at addr 0x7fff... stacktrace shows kernel oops. PCI reset attempted and failed.``` 
priya-ml: given fused kernel is implicated, recommend immediate rollback to previous kernel variant or disable fused kernels via env `FUSED_KERNELS=0` on runtime pods.
ben-runtime: I patched the deployment with env change for canary subset (10%): `kubectl set env deploy/runtime --container runtime FUSED_KERNELS=0 --record` — canary pods healthy.
alice-sre: scaling other nodes: `kops scale --name runtime-prod-eu --per-zone 2` done. Evicting pods from node-nv06: `kubectl drain node-nv06 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — eviction in progress.
jordan-support: HealthFin reports degraded inference responses but no data loss. Provided ETA 30-45m for recovery. Customer NOC updated.
sasha-product: flagging customers for potential SLA credits. Please collect affected request IDs and timeframe.
ben-runtime: Canary looks good — no segfaults after disabling fused kernels. Rolling patch to remaining pods now.
alice-sre: monitoring for node reboots and additional oops. We'll keep node-nv06 cordoned until hardware validation.
priya-ml: reminder to run bisection and instrument the fused kernel path — capturing a core from canary would help but crashloops prevented that. Use `gcore` on non-crash pod.
alice-sre: status — routing fallback completed, fused kernels disabled platform-wide, affected tenants on runtime-legacy or cpu-backend, error rate down to baseline (~2%). Declaring incident mitigated for customer impact. Will schedule a postmortem. :white_check_mark:
ben-runtime: handing off to oncall rotation — @mike-sre will own followups and postmortem. Thanks everyone.
mike-sre: ack. I'll open incident ticket and attach logs, driver dumps, and action timeline.
incident-bot: Incident update: P1->Mitigated. Recording responder list and timeline. Reminder: please file a postmortem within 72h.
